description_en: Releases a Web Application Firewall (WAF) 3.0 instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi release-instance --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to view the current WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region to which the WAF instance belongs. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: indicates the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
